title: ONT methylation pipeline parameters
description: Parameter validation for the ONT methylation Nextflow pipeline

input.description: CSV sample sheet containing sample, bam and assembly columns
input.errorMessage: Input file name must end in '.csv' and cannot contain spaces

automatic_threshold_modkit.description: Enable automatic estimation of the filter threshold by modkit. When true, true, modkit will determine an optimal threshold from the data and the value of --filter_threshold_modkit will be ignored.

percent_cutoff_modification_table.description: Minimum methylation percentage required for genome positions to be reported in the modification tables
